newsitem.title: FINLAND: AAMULEHTI - 97 PROFIT TO AT LEAST MATCH 96.
newsitem.headline: AAMULEHTI - 97 PROFIT TO AT LEAST MATCH 96.

text.p: Finnish media group Aamulehti-yhtyma Oy said on Friday it expected full-year net sales to be flat and earnings to at least match last year's.

"Consolidated net sales for the full year are expected to remain at last year's level ... The group's result is predicted to reach at least last year's level," Aamulehti said in a statement with its January-April results.
In 1996, Aamulehti's net sales were 1.62 billion markka and profit before extraordinary items and tax was 155 million markka.
Its January-April profit before extras and tax rose 59 percent on the year-ago period to 51 million markka -- well above the median and near the top of the range of forecasts in a Reuters poll.
Aamulehti and Finnish commercial television company MTV Oy announced this spring that they intend to merge from the start of 1998.
